falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,000 for three consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above a key historical resistance level would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by confirming a bullish trend contrary to the current unknown verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A surge in volume would indicate extreme market participation, directly contradicting the 'HOLD' signal's implication of indecision or lack of clear momentum.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 80 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant rise in the blowoff score would confirm a blowoff top scenario, falsifying the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by showing clear evidence of a topping pattern.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
